doc: Used by the device to report the transfer hook status upon completion. Used for both pre and post hooks.

mappings.description: Transfer ID (UUID) for the related file transfer
mappings.doc: Can be either for download or upload transfers.
Specifies the direction of the transfer. Allowed values: 'server_to_device' or 'device_to_server'.

mappings.description: Specifies the phase of the hook
mappings.doc: Specifies which hook of the transfer. Allowed values: 'pre_hook' or 'post_hook'.

mappings.description: Success or error code for the hook
mappings.doc: Error code while executing the hook. A 0 code is a success, errors are POSIX errno.

mappings.description: Status code returned by the hook
mappings.doc: On unix system, it's the status code returned by the hook execution.
